name: openaca
description: Agent supply-chain security tooling from OpenACA, the open advisory and composition layer for AI agent components.

plugins.name: openaca
plugins.description: Scan your Claude Code setup for vulnerable or malicious agent components. Inventories MCP servers, plugins, skills, and hooks, matches them against OpenACA's OSV-compatible advisory corpus plus configuration-hygiene posture rules, generates an Agent BOM, and triages results into ranked exposure reports.
